pages.headline: A retainer stays unsigned or a provider does not reply. A paralegal opens the matter, searches email and picks up the phone.
pages.body: An unsigned retainer. Missing provider records. A matter without an attorney. A case with no recent touch. A settlement waiting to close. A deposition still unconfirmed. Each needs evidence gathered, a person reached and an outcome recorded. The case system already holds stages, checklists and reports; Orcaworks coordinates the handoffs across Outlook, DocuSign, portals and people around that case record.
pages.callout: 48% of firms could not be reached by phone, even after an opportunity to return messages.
pages.calloutSource: Clio · 2024 Legal Trends Report · 500-firm client-intake study

pages.eyebrow: 01 / Intake · Qualified lead to retained matter
pages.title: Intake-to-retainer coordination
pages.problem: A qualified prospective client is ready to proceed, but the intake specialist still has to reach an attorney, confirm conflict status, arrange an investigator where needed and chase the retainer. Calls, photos, signing links and onboarding documents sit in different places while the lead waits for someone to complete the handoff.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks brings intake, conflict-review status, investigator replies and signing evidence together. The attorney decides acceptance; approved follow-ups continue until the signed retainer and required onboarding documents are recorded in the matter and ready for the team.

rightContent.label: of firms reached by phone explained the process and next steps.
rightContent.source: Clio · 2024 Legal Trends Report · 500-firm client-intake study

pages.title: Records & evidence readiness
pages.problem: The case checklist calls for medical records and bills, but a provider has returned only part of the treatment period. A records coordinator reopens the request, checks PDFs and portal messages, calls the provider and updates a tracker. The attorney still cannot tell whether the file is ready for demand.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks compares received documents with the matter checklist, requests missing items and tracks provider responses. It checks identity, dates and readability, links each source and routes the assembled file to the attorney for legal sufficiency review.

rightContent.quote: Covered entities generally must act on an individual’s medical-record access request within 30 calendar days.
rightContent.source: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services · HIPAA Privacy Rule

pages.title: Governed case assignment
pages.problem: A qualified matter is unassigned. The intake team checks venue, language, case type, referral flags and the attorney rotation, then asks who can take it. Case counts, calendars and recent allocations disagree. A special matter may need a partner decision, but the supporting facts are scattered across notes and spreadsheets.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks assembles the eligible attorney set using the firm’s rotation, geography and capacity rules. Standard recommendations and special-case exceptions go to the intake attorney or partner; only an approved assignment becomes the matter’s recorded owner.

rightContent.quote: Workload allocation is a crucial aspect of legal efficiency
rightContent.source: ACC · 2025 Law Department Management Benchmarking Report

pages.eyebrow: 04 / Case operations · Aging and no-touch exceptions
pages.title: Stalled-case progression
pages.problem: The aging report flags a matter with no recent touch. A case manager checks notes, emails, records requests and appointments to find out why. Is the client still treating, is a provider late, has the attorney deferred the next step, or was completed work never entered? The report identifies the question.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks reconstructs the matter’s current state, asks the owner for missing context and separates an external blocker from stale data. The supervising attorney approves legal changes; permitted follow-up leaves an explained status, named owner and next action.

rightContent.alt: Two lawyers reviewing documents at a courtroom counsel table beside a gavel

pages.headline: Turn the aging flag into an explained blocker and a next action.
pages.explanation: A no-touch exception starts an investigation. Compare the stage and checklist with correspondence, outstanding requests and owner input. Keep legitimate waiting states visible; route any legal or strategic change to the supervising attorney.

valuePoints.title: Investigate the exception

valuePoints.description: External treatment, court and provider delays stay explicit with a responsible owner.

valuePoints.title: Give the matter a next action
valuePoints.description: Track time from an aging flag to a confirmed blocker, next action and owner.

pages.title: Settlement & case closeout readiness
pages.problem: The matter is marked settled, but the release is unsigned, a lien balance is unconfirmed or accounting is waiting for approval. A settlement coordinator checks DocuSign, provider correspondence, costs and the disbursement worksheet. Until those dependencies agree, the attorney cannot authorize closeout and the client still waits for payment.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks assembles the release, lien and cost evidence, signing status and accounting confirmations into a closeout packet. It coordinates missing items; attorneys and authorized finance staff retain settlement, lien, disbursement and money decisions before closure updates.

rightContent.quote: Medicare conditional payments must be repaid when a settlement, judgment, award or other payment is secured.
rightContent.source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services · Medicare Secondary Payer Recovery

pages.title: Legal scheduling coordination
pages.problem: A deposition has a proposed date, but opposing counsel has not confirmed, the witness has a conflict and the attorney’s calendar has changed. A legal assistant compares email replies, Outlook and the case calendar, then resends options. An entry on one calendar still does not mean the event is confirmed.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks gathers availability and tracks each party’s response against the court notice and authoritative deadline record. The attorney or authorized paralegal confirms the permitted slot; consistent case and calendar updates follow, with unresolved conflicts escalated.

rightContent.alt: Gavel beside a calendar with a red pin marking a court date

pages.title: Keep every handoff accountable
beforeItems: Intake, records and signing updates sit in separate inboxes.
Staff reconstruct the same matter context before each decision.
Approval requests reach attorneys without all supporting evidence.
The case record is updated after calls and emails are complete.
afterItems: A matter-linked view brings the evidence and outstanding requests together.
The next action has an owner, an approval point and a clear completion state.
Attorneys review the evidence for acceptance, legal sufficiency and settlement.
Approved actions and their outcomes return to the case record.
